oracle_diagnostics.information: Current public verified legal graph, historical baseline state. observation_prior uses unknown-family public prior; known_parameter_missing knows family, actor biases/response rates but integrates missing features uniformly; full_truth also knows missing soft truth. All integrate future pair Gaussian/outcomes rather than seeing realized random draws. No future arrivals/exits/pending schedule or outcome stream is optimized.
oracle_diagnostics.not_bound: Static maximum expected current reward along baseline trajectories; dynamic state distribution would change if deployed, so gains are neither attainable policy effect nor an upper bound. No hidden hard-field graph expansion.
